instruction: A candid medium-shot photograph of a minimalist indoor room with white walls and light wooden flooring. On the left, the man in the brown sweater (R1) sits in a light wooden armchair, looking down and writing in a notebook on his lap. On the right, the man in the white t-shirt (R2) sits on a teal velvet chair, holding a glass of water in both hands and looking toward the man in the brown sweater. The scene is brightly lit with soft, even light and gentle shadows.
